en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 16 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Mehran from Muhammad bin Ali from Abi Ali Khazzaz from Dawood bin Sulaiman that he said:

I said to Abu Ibrahim [Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s)]: I am afraid that something may happen and I will not be able to meet you. So tell me who the Imam is after you? Imam (a.s) replied: My son, so-and-so, meaning Abul Hasan [Imam Ali Ridha].
